proof_body:
by
  intro a α β x ha hα hαβ
  have hβ : 0 < β := hα.trans hαβ
  have h1 : Real.logb a α < x ↔ α < a ^ x := Real.logb_lt_iff_lt_rpow ha hα
  have h2 : x < Real.logb a β ↔ a ^ x < β := Real.lt_logb_iff_rpow_lt ha hβ
  rw [h1, h2]
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · by_contra h3
      have h4 := not_lt.1 h3
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 h4) (sub_nonneg.2 (h4.trans hαβ.le))]
    · by_contra h3
      have h4 := not_lt.1 h3
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 (hαβ.le.trans h4)) (sub_nonneg.2 h4)]
  · rintro ⟨h3, h4⟩
    exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (sub_pos.2 h3) (sub_neg.2 h4)
target_source: ∀ (a α β x : ℝ), 1 < a → 0 < α → α < β → ((a ^ x - α) * (a ^ x - β) < 0 ↔ Real.logb a α < x ∧ x < Real.logb a β)
